body.name: Donor-conditional reduced coordinates
body.construction: On \(G_n\), \(D_n=\widehat S^{-1}\), \(Z_{p,n}=(R\widehat V)^{\top}/\sigma\), \(Z_{q,n}=\widehat U^{\top}C/\sigma\), \(m_{p,n}=(u\widehat V)^{\top}/\sigma\), \(m_{q,n}=\widehat U^{\top}v/\sigma\), \(Z_n=(Z_{p,n}^{\top},Z_{q,n}^{\top})^{\top}\), \(m_n=(m_{p,n}^{\top},m_{q,n}^{\top})^{\top}\), and \(\xi_n=Z_n-m_n\)
